parallelize_model: parallelize a PyTorch model using FSDP sharding, tensor parallelism, float8 conversion, and selective activation checkpointing
get_device_mesh: create a CUDA device mesh with data parallel replicate, shard, and tensor parallel dimensions for distributed training
setup_torch_distributed: initialize torch distributed process group with NCCL backend for single GPU, multi-GPU, or SLURM jobs
check_model_value_range: check a PyTorch model parameters and buffers for NaN, Inf, suspicious range, or all-zero values
dist_mean: compute the mean of a scalar value across all processes in a distributed device mesh using all_reduce
